seed_pairing: partition seed s paired with training seed 42+s, matched across alphas
method: Original CIFAR-10 PyTorch FedAvg job/client; experiment adapter replaces split_and_save with the new partition utility and exports site-*.npy. Seed-specific model copies change only constructor default seed; model source verified at server and all eight clients.
validation: Every partition covers all 50,000 samples exactly once
50 rounds and 8 clients verified for each trial
All 200 mean/SD curve points independently recomputed from raw seed curves
curve_definition: Site-1 common-test global-model accuracy before each local training round, averaged at matching rounds across five seeds; sample SD (ddof=1), not confidence intervals; no temporal smoothing.
final_metric_definition: Common-test accuracy evaluated from the checkpoint after round 50, mean and sample SD across five seeds.
historical_note: default_rng produces different partitions from legacy global np.random for the same seed, so exact historical README scores are not expected. An earlier exploratory alpha=0.1 attempt produced NaNs in round 6; the unchanged rerun succeeded. That exploratory attempt is not part of this new 20-trial cohort.
